text_block_list.text:
—Summer training camp. That time of year 
had come once again.

A special intensive training period for 
the Umamusume. It's also an event to catch 
their breath, but...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Trainer-san! There's a group of 
people heading straight for us!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What is that? Everyone's wearing clown 
masks!

Hyottoko, Okame, Crow Tengu, Fox. People 
wearing all kinds of masks pass by...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oho, that's a Kagura dance mask, isn't 
it~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes! In this country, it has long been a 
tradition to wear masks and dance during 
festivals!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Those people just now must be practicing 
their dance for the summer festival!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The dancers are fools, and the watchers 
are fools too. If both are fools, you'd 
better dance, hey, hey♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's all from your Japanese seasonal 
tradition specialist, Matikanefukukitaru!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Lucha libre, or rather, a 
mascarada!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
To think there are people in this country 
too who hide their identities behind masks 
and dance!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, this is a challenge to El-El! It's 
telling me to join the festival!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If you know no fear, then leap right into 
my embrace!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I will neither run nor hide! 
I'll barge right in with my head held high 
for a dance battle, yeeees!

El Condor Pasa burns with passion over an 
unexpected form of entertainment. This 
summer looks like it'll be quite different 
from the last.
